stem: He ____ to the training center to practice his skills every Tuesday.
reason: every Tuesday表示习惯动作，用一般现在时；主语He为第三人称单数，填goes。

stem: The best way to keep fit is to ____ healthy eating habits.
reason: develop healthy eating habits表示养成健康饮食习惯，develop与habits搭配。

stem: The employee's demand for a pay rise was turned ____ by his boss.
reason: 加薪要求被老板拒绝，用turn down；turn in为上交，turn over为翻转或移交，turn up为出现或调大。

stem: Peter ____ his old friend yesterday while he was shopping at the supermarket.
reason: 购物时偶遇老朋友用come across，过去式came across；look into为调查，take after为像某人。

stem: Great changes ____ in our country for the past ten years.
reason: for the past ten years联系现在，用现在完成时；take place无被动语态，复数changes接have。

stem: The plan ____ good, but you should discuss it with your parents first.
reason: 评价计划听起来不错，用sounds good；taste、smell针对味道或气味，feel不对应听取计划的语境。

stem: On Monday mornings it usually ____ me an hour to drive to work.
reason: usually表示日常习惯，It takes sb time to do表示做某事花时间，形式主语it接takes。

stem: You ____ drive so fast! It is dangerous.
reason: 指出危险并劝告不要开太快，用shouldn't表示不应当；couldn't表过去不能。

stem: There was a thick fog this morning, so the planes did not ____ as scheduled.
reason: 飞机受浓雾影响未按时起飞，take off表示起飞，did not后用原形。

stem: You'd better ____ a copy of the whole article for yourself.
reason: had better后接动词原形，make a copy表示复制一份。

stem: Lucy will go home for a vacation as soon as she ____ her exams.
reason: as soon as引导将来时间从句，主将从现；主语she接finishes。

stem: The car ____ on the highway and the driver tried to repair it.
reason: 后句说司机尝试修车，说明汽车发生故障，用broke down。

stem: In order to protect the river, the villagers didn't allow us to ____ a factory there.
reason: 建立工厂用set up；give up为放弃，look up为查阅，take up为开始从事或占用。

stem: The old lady spoke in such a low voice that I did not ____ what she said.
reason: 声音太低导致没听清，catch what sb said表示听清某人的话，不是接受或收到信息的accept、receive。

stem: We'll go to the park for a picnic if the weather ____ fine tomorrow.
reason: if引导将来条件从句用一般现在时；weather为单数，stay作系动词表示保持，填stays。

stem: You ____ leave at six o'clock, or you'll be late for work.
reason: 否则上班迟到说明六点离开是必要的，用must，不是仅表示许可的may。

stem: We didn't expect the manager to ____ at the party. We thought he was still in hospital.
reason: 原以为经理住院，没想到出现在聚会上，用turn up表示出现。

stem: Sorry, but we cannot go to New York. Our friends ____ to see us next Sunday.
reason: next Sunday表示将来安排，come可用现在进行时are coming表达已安排的来访。

stem: It is ____ that he is the richest man in our town.
reason: It is said that … 为据说的固定被动结构，空中用过去分词said。

stem: Last Thursday Peter ____ to give a speech at the opening ceremony.
reason: Last Thursday表过去，Peter是被邀请者，用was invited。

stem: Yesterday several young men ____ the bank of a large sum of money.
reason: rob sb/a place of sth表示从某人或某地抢走财物；steal应接被偷的物品，不用此处结构。

stem: By the end of last week, we ____ 2,000 words.
reason: 截至上周末是过去的参照点，此前已学完用过去完成时had learned。

stem: They will have a picnic if it ____ fine next Saturday.
reason: if引导将来条件从句，主句will have，从句用一般现在时is。
